ASP is Finland’s “first‑time home saver” account. Anyone 15 years or older can open one and make monthly deposits. The account earns 1 % interest each year, added on 31 December.

A bonus of 4 % is also earned. It accrues during the opening year and the next five calendar years. The bonus isn’t paid out each year – it’s paid later, when you buy your first home using the ASP savings together with a qualifying loan, and only after you have made at least 20 approved monthly deposits. Pausing deposits is allowed, but each pause delays reaching the 20‑deposit count. If you close the account for another reason, you lose the bonus and the earned interest is taxed at 30 %.

**Key points**
- Open at any age ≥ 15 (no upper limit since June 2026).  
- 1 % yearly interest, added on 31 December.  
- 4 % bonus interest accrues for the opening year + 5 years.  
- Bonus paid only when you purchase your first home with the ASP savings and a loan, after ≥ 20 deposits.  
- Paused deposits delay the deposit count but don’t stop interest accrual.  
- Closing the account early cancels the bonus and triggers 30 % tax on interest.

Let me know if you’d like help checking how many deposits you’ve already made or setting up a regular transfer for your 400 € monthly saving.
